description: Labeled queries for filings-search-eval (ADR-0011). Made on 2026-10-08 for the local database of the watchlist run: 277 filings (256 Form 4, 21 8-K) filed 2026-09-08 to 2026-10-06. Relevance was judged by reading every 8-K's stored summary and every Form 4's headline and transaction codes (form4_filings), not from search results: a filing is relevant when someone typing the query would want it on the first page. Each query lists all the filings judged relevant, so recall can be measured; a query with more than 5 relevant filings can't reach recall@5 = 1. Queries cover the examples ADR-0011 tested, plain words that summaries don't use, names, and Form 4 topics. All accession numbers are public SEC data.

queries.note: Chevron elects Jeff Gustavson chief financial officer. The summary says 'elected' and 'Chief Financial Officer', never 'CFO' or 'appointment'.
Oracle: Larry Ellison cancelled his 10b5-1 plan. Form 4s made 'under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan' share the words but are not cancellations.
Amazon's £4.25 billion note offering and Exxon Mobil's floating rate notes. Tesla's credit facilities are bank loans, not an offering (see 'credit facility').

Every Form 4 with an open-market purchase (transaction code P): Berkshire Hathaway and Warren Buffett buying Lennar (4), a Salesforce director, an Oracle director. Grants and option exercises are not purchases.
Earnings releases: Oracle Q1 FY27, Adobe Q3 FY26, Costco Q4 FY26, Nike Q1 FY27. Tesla's production and deliveries report has no financial results (see 'electric vehicle deliveries').
Executive changes: Adobe's new CEO and executive chair, Chevron's officer changes and new CFO. New directors have their own query ('new board member').
Adobe's Q3 results, the only filing that mentions buying back its own shares (9.5 million in the quarter). Berkshire buying Lennar shares is an investment, not a repurchase.
The four Form 4s filed jointly by Berkshire Hathaway and Warren E Buffett (Lennar purchases). Ajit Jain's Berkshire Form 4 doesn't involve Buffett.
AMD agrees to acquire World Labs for $8.2 billion. Chevron's Hess Midstream deal is a divestiture.
Director appointments: Kevin Mandia at Amazon, Alexandre Arnault at Nike, Joaquin Duato at PepsiCo. Form 4s of directors' stock grants don't announce appointments.
Adobe: Anil Chakravarthy succeeds Shantanu Narayen as CEO.
Tesla's $30 billion of credit facilities with Citibank and Wells Fargo.
Oracle's Q1 release, which declares common and preferred dividends; no other filing declares one.
Visa deposits $405 million into its U.S. litigation escrow account.
Nike's Pace transformation: about $2.5 billion of savings, $1.0 billion of charges, severance. McDonald's NEXT strategy is about growth, not cost cutting.
Salesforce's Investor Day presentation and UnitedHealth's presentation at the Wells Fargo healthcare conference.
Tesla's Q3 2026 production and deliveries. The summary never says 'electric'.
Nike's annual meeting results: shareholders approved the amended employee stock purchase plan and voted on directors and the auditor.
Every Form 4 reporting a gift (transaction code G), alone or with other transactions: Eli Lilly, Microsoft, Nvidia, Apple, AMD, Broadcom, Nike insiders.
Nvidia's CEO files as 'Jen Hsun Huang': the one Form 4 he filed (a gift of 438,000 shares). Keyword search matches only 'Huang', through its any-word fallback.
